description: This is a test file for the system-run-approval-binding module. It contains unit tests written with the Vitest testing framework, testing functions such as normalizeSystemRunApprovalPlan, buildSystemRunApprovalEnvBinding, buildSystemRunApprovalBinding, matchSystemRunApprovalEnvHash, matchSystemRunApprovalBinding, and missingSystemRunApprovalBinding. The tests verify normalization, hashing, matching, and error reporting functionalities related to system run approval bindings.

methods.name: normalizeSystemRunApprovalPlan
methods.description: Function that normalizes the system run approval plan input, converting file paths to standardized form, handling optional fields, and validating input.

methods.name: buildSystemRunApprovalEnvBinding
methods.description: Constructs an environment binding object with a hash of the environment variables, filtering and sorting keys.

methods.name: buildSystemRunApprovalBinding
methods.description: Creates a binding object from provided arguments, normalizing argv and other metadata, and associating the environment hash.

methods.name: matchSystemRunApprovalEnvHash
methods.description: Compares expected and actual environment hash and keys, returning an object indicating whether they match or describing mismatches.

methods.name: matchSystemRunApprovalBinding
methods.description: Checks whether actual binding details match the expected, including arguments, cwd, agentId, sessionKey, and envHash.

methods.name: missingSystemRunApprovalBinding
methods.description: Reports missing or mismatched environment keys in approval binding request validation.
